headline: Weathered Expanse Flares Amid Bitter Clashes As Linn Of Mercy Calms
war_summary: Fresh fighting has erupted across Weathered Expanse, where four base exchanges within the past two hours around Crow’s Nest and Frostmarch have produced nearly two thousand casualties, making it the war's most volatile sector. Along the eastern front, Stlican Shelf witnessed renewed friction with three base actions at Thornhold in the last six hours, leaving the hex partitioned between five Warden and four Colonial strongholds. In contrast, the furious contest that previously battered Linn of Mercy has cooled markedly to a mere handful of casualties following early-morning struggles over Rotdust. Territorial lines have similarly frozen in Stonecradle, though slaughter there continues unabated, claiming over 2,800 combined casualties in the last two hours as enlistments surge. Sustained attrition also grips Callahan’s Passage and Farranac Coast, where rising casualties reflect persistent pressure despite unchanged lines. Meanwhile, quiet has returned to Fisherman’s Row and The Gutter, where earlier territorial gains have solidified without further disturbance.
